name: Speaker Referring Expression Production
summary: Speakers choose which single word to utter to refer to a highlighted target robot in context.

charter.question: When participants act as speakers choosing a referring expression for a target object, do they avoid words shared with visually similar competitors or follow standard RSA informativity?

instructions.welcome: Welcome! In this study you will play the role of a speaker helping a listener find a target robot.
instructions.task: On each screen one target robot is highlighted. Choose which single word you would say so a listener who sees the same robots can pick out the highlighted target robot.

comprehension_checks.question: What is your goal on each screen?
options: Choose a word that describes the highlighted target robot so a listener can identify it.
Click on a robot that has no features.
Choose a word that is false of the target robot.
